name: PROSPECT
full_name: Precision Reactor Oscillation and Spectrum Experiment
summary: PROSPECT measured the uranium-235 antineutrino spectrum and searched for metre-scale sterile oscillations at Oak Ridge HFIR. Its optically segmented detector was designed for operation at the surface close to a compact highly enriched reactor core.
detection_principle: Lithium-6-loaded liquid scintillator tags inverse beta decay. Positron energy and delayed lithium-capture pulses are localized by segmentation; pulse-shape discrimination rejects neutron and gamma backgrounds. Relative spectra across detector baselines test oscillations.

status.evidence: The community white paper reports that the original PROSPECT detector was decommissioned in 2020. The 2018 sample is a data-taking period, not the entire lifetime of the apparatus.

Original detector decommissioned; PROSPECT-II developed as a successor
